description_en: Executes a stage in a process
description_zh: 调用此接口，可以执行发布流程的指定阶段
kebab_example: aliyun dataworks-public exec-pipeline-run-stage --project-id 10000 --id a7ef0634-20ec-4a7c-a214-54020f91XXXX --code DEV_CHECK --api-version 2024-05-18 --region cn-hangzhou
name: ExecPipelineRunStage

parameters.help_en: The DataWorks workspace ID. You can log on to the [DataWorks console](https://workbench.data.aliyun.com/console) and go to the Workspace page to query the ID
parameters.help_zh: DataWorks工作空间的ID。您可以登录[DataWorks控制台](https://workbench.data.aliyun.com/console)，进入工作空间配置页面获取工作空间ID
parameters.name: project_id

parameters.help_zh: 发布流程的唯一标识符
parameters.name: id

parameters.help_en: The code of the stage in the process. You can call the GetDeployment operation to query the code
parameters.help_zh: 表示发布流程阶段的代码，具体以GetPipelineRun接口的返回值为准
parameters.name: code
